Subject: Initial vendor onboarding + payment ladder alignment / early-pay interest

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. We're ready to get Acme set up as a Redwood supplier so we can start receiving POs for the integration work and the month-to-month support retainer. A few items from our side so we can align the onboarding checklist: 

- Current invoicing cadence: we bill monthly with Net45.
- We'd like to explore harmonizing to Net30 to match Redwood’s standard program for recurring services.
- Also interested in an early-pay option (we can offer 1.5% discount for payment within 15 days) — curious if Redwood runs a pilot program for early-pay enrollments.

Attached are our W-9 and ACH form for vendor setup. Can you confirm the PO process and any additional onboarding forms you need? We can return signed paperwork quickly if you send the DocuSign link.

Quick ask: can we get a tentative PO issuance date once the onboarding form is complete? We have a kickoff the week after next.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Head of Finance Operations
Acme Platforms, Inc.
(415) 555-8210

Attachments: Acme_W9.pdf (pdf), Acme_ACH_Form.pdf (pdf)

Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial vendor onboarding + payment ladder alignment / early-pay interest

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the forms. 

Short answers up front: yes, we can onboard Acme; yes, we can issue an initial PO once the vendor packet is complete; and we do run short-term early-pay pilots for partner suppliers but need finance signoff.

Next steps I propose:
1) Please complete the Redwood Vendor Onboarding Form (attached) and return via the DocuSign link below. The form captures billing address, remittance instructions, tax details and primary contact for PO acknowledgements.
2) Once we have the form and the ACH/W-9 verified, Procurement issues a PO using our Redwood_PO_Template.pdf and will send it to your billing inbox.
3) For the early-pay offer you mentioned (1.5% at net15), I've looped in Karthik (Finance) to evaluate the pilot cadence and impact. If Finance approves, we'll run a 60-day pilot where payments for delivered invoices are evaluated for early-pay enrollment.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/txn/abc123-acme-po-sign
Attached: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf, Redwood_PO_Template.pdf

Can you confirm who at your AP team will receive POs and whether the stated remittance info on the ACH form is your primary remit? We aim to issue the PO within 3 business days after the completed onboarding packet is returned.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks for looping me in. Finance is open to a time-boxed early-pay pilot provided: 
- The supplier provides ACH and W-9 (received).
- We have the vendor onboarding form on file and the PO is for recurring monthly services (not one-off consulting).
- Max exposure capped at $150k during pilot.

Assuming those conditions, Finance will approve a 60-day pilot at 1.5% early-pay discount with payments processed net45 by default and early-pay settlements within 15 days when enrolled. We'll monitor volume and DSO impacts.

I'll draft a short EarlyPay_SLA and send it for signatures. Marissa — if you can share the volume estimates (monthly cadence + anticipated first invoice date), we can finalize the cap and enrollment criteria.
